name: duchamp
description: Competitor ad research for coding agents: long-running ads, keyframes and transcripts over MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Research long-running ads, from your agent
interface.longDescription: Duchamp gives Codex the ads curated advertisers have kept running for 90+ days with research materials: timestamped keyframes, the speech transcript, full body copy, the landing URL and observed numbers. Your agent does the analysis on your own Codex subscription. Duchamp does not reproduce ads.
